checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One playable vertical reel of about 8 seconds
must.why: 8 s 9:16 clip with sound (peak -1.5 dB); frames are vertical.
Dog, beach pair, woman and lake are visible in the sampled frames. No sampled frame shows the cat, so it cannot be confirmed.

must.item: Visible playful treatment (bouncy motion, lively transitions, overlays)
must.why: Sampled frames show natural motion (wink, tongue out) but no overlays or visible transition effects. Whip-pans cannot be judged from stills.

must.item: Faces and pets remain recognizable and unobscured
must.why: Dog, couple and woman are clear and unobstructed. The beach pair is reframed wider, with slightly altered faces.

must.item: Single edited sequence, not separate clips or a contact sheet
must.why: One continuous video file with the shots in sequence.

faults.what: Cat shot not visible in any sampled frame, so the shocked-cat requirement is unverified.
Beach couple is regenerated with a wider, different composition (full torso and arm around her). Faces differ slightly from the photo.
Dog pose differs from the original: it sits turned sideways with its head turned. Its look is still consistent with the original.
No visible humorous overlays or text. The playfulness relies on the AI motion alone.

summary: A clean 8-second vertical AI reel with the dog, beach friends, winking woman and lake all recognizable; the cat shot and the whip-pan transitions can't be confirmed from the frames, and the faces are slightly regenerated.
